usedFor: Recall.ai records and transcribes meetings, LeadConnector holds contacts, and “New Transcript Completed” can start “Add or Remove Contact from Workflow”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Transcript Completed” in Recall.ai, then “Add or Remove Contact from Workflow” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: A finished transcript can add or remove a contact from a LeadConnector workflow by Contact ID, email or phone.

watchOut: “New Recording Becomes Ready” in Recall.ai is polling and takes a lookback window in minutes, so it is not instant.
